topic.label: Design and User Experience
topic.desc: Design and User Experience: Design Theory, History and Critique, Interaction and UX Design, Visual Communication and Graphic Design, Design Research and Human-Centered Methods, Typography and Industrial and Product Design.

concepts.label: Design Research and Human-Centered Methods
concepts.desc: Understanding people, contexts and needs through interviews, observation and synthesis before committing to a form.

concepts.label: Design Theory, History and Critique
concepts.desc: Movements, principles and critical vocabulary used to evaluate and situate design work, including accessibility and ethics.

concepts.label: Interaction and UX Design
concepts.desc: Designing how people move through digital products: flows, states, feedback and information architecture.

concepts.label: Industrial and Product Design
concepts.desc: Designing physical objects for function, ergonomics, materials and manufacture.

concepts.label: Typography
concepts.desc: The selection, pairing and setting of type for legibility, tone and rhythm across media.

concepts.label: Visual Communication and Graphic Design
concepts.desc: Composition, color, imagery and hierarchy used to communicate a message clearly in print and on screen.

skills.label: Research Insight Synthesizer
skills.desc: Clusters interview notes into themes and personas and checks every insight against quoted evidence.

skills.label: User Interview Planner
skills.desc: Writes a research plan and interview guide for a design question and checks questions for leading or biased wording.

skills.label: Usability Test Runner
skills.desc: Runs task-based usability tests on a prototype and checks findings by severity and frequency across participants.

skills.label: Accessibility Auditor
skills.desc: Audits designs against WCAG criteria and checks contrast, focus order, target size and screen reader labels.

skills.label: Design Critique Writer
skills.desc: Writes structured critique of a design against its goals and principles and checks each claim against visible evidence.

skills.label: Design Movement Contextualizer
skills.desc: Places a work within design history movements and checks attributions against cited sources.

skills.label: Information Architecture Mapper
skills.desc: Organizes content into navigation and labeling schemes and checks findability with card sort results.

skills.label: Interactive Prototype Builder
skills.desc: Builds clickable prototypes with states and transitions and checks them against the specified flow.

skills.label: Wireframe Builder
skills.desc: Produces low-fidelity wireframes of screens and flows and checks that every user task has a complete path.

skills.label: Concept Sketcher
skills.desc: Generates form concepts through sketch iterations and checks each against the functional requirements list.

skills.label: Ergonomics Evaluator
skills.desc: Evaluates product dimensions against anthropometric data and checks reach, grip and posture limits.

skills.label: Material and Process Selector
skills.desc: Chooses materials and manufacturing processes for a part and checks cost, strength and sustainability trade-offs.

skills.label: Typeface Pairer
skills.desc: Selects complementary typefaces for a brief and checks legibility at body and display sizes.

skills.label: Type Scale Builder
skills.desc: Defines a modular type scale with line heights and checks vertical rhythm across breakpoints.

skills.label: Brand Identity Designer
skills.desc: Develops logo, mark and identity guidelines for a brief and checks consistency across sample applications.

skills.label: Color System Builder
skills.desc: Builds a color palette with semantic roles and checks contrast ratios for every foreground and background pair.

skills.label: Layout Composer
skills.desc: Arranges content on a grid with a clear visual hierarchy and checks alignment, spacing and reading order.
